effects: The signer sends `shares` prestoUSDCv vault shares to the withdrawal queue with safeTransferFrom. This spends the signer's share allowance to the queue.
The queue mints a withdrawal NFT (a new tokenId) to `receiver`. Only the NFT owner can later claim the underlying assets.
The assets come later, at the rate of the fill. Nothing arrives in this transaction.
The queue calls the vault delegator's sweepPending(). This does not move the signer's assets.
formats.shown: Request queued withdrawal: queue {shares} prestoUSDCv, with the withdrawal NFT sent to {receiver}, and the vault shown as an address.

findings.title: requestRedeem labels receiver 'NFT recipient' but never says that address alone can claim the withdrawn assets
findings.evidence: WithdrawalQueue.sol requestRedeem: `_mint(receiver, tokenId);` and claim: `if (ownerOf(tokenId) != msg.sender) revert NotTokenOwner();`. Descriptor: label "NFT recipient", interpolatedIntent "Queue {shares}, NFT to {receiver}".
findings.fix: Change the label to "Withdrawal claim owner". Change interpolatedIntent to "Queue {shares} for withdrawal, claim right to {receiver}".

findings.title: requestRedeem cannot show the underlying asset amount, which the later fill rate decides
findings.evidence: WithdrawalQueue.sol fill: `assets = IERC4626(vault).redeem(shares, address(this), address(this));` runs later, and claimable() computes assets from the fill checkpoints.

effects: The signer (who must own NFT `tokenId`) sends the filled part of the withdrawal, paid in the vault's underlying asset, to `receiver`.
The claimed shares are recorded on the request. The NFT stays with the signer, and an unfilled remainder can be claimed later.
If nothing is filled yet, the transfer is 0.
formats.shown: Claim filled withdrawal {tokenId} to {receiver}, with the vault address and the raw NFT id.

findings.title: claim cannot show the asset amount or token: both come from storage and the vault
findings.evidence: WithdrawalQueue.sol claim: `(assets, shares) = claimable(tokenId);` and `IERC20(IERC4626(vault).asset()).safeTransfer(receiver, assets);`. The descriptor shows only the tokenId and the receiver.

findings.title: claim intent does not say the claim can be partial or zero while the NFT stays with the signer
findings.evidence: WithdrawalQueue.sol claimable: `uint256 endShares = Math.min(request.prevRequestSum + request.shares, totalFilled());`. claim does not burn the NFT. Intent: "Claim filled withdrawal".
